{"has_issues": true, "issues": ["Lender count mismatch: claims a syndicate of 13 institutions but lists 14 banks (Fifth Third, East West, Wells Fargo, Truist, Western Alliance, First-Citizens, Zions/California Bank & Trust, Preferred, Texas Capital, Flagstar, Bank of Hope, Sunflower Bank, City National, Axos).", "Amendment frequency inconsistency: memo identifies this as Amendment No. 2 (with Amendment No. 1 on 2024-12-09) yet later asserts there have been three amendments within five months."]}
